summary: BabyMix full-stack MVP tested end-to-end. Backend: 7/7 pytest cases passing including /api/ health, 400 validation errors (missing/invalid base64), and real Gemini Nano Banana baby generation for gender=random/male/female. Frontend: Welcome screen renders with title, badge, feature row and start CTA; navigation to Upload screen works; father-card, mother-card, gender segmented (male/female/random), generate-button (correctly disabled with aria-disabled=true when no photos uploaded), and back-button all present and functional. Gender segment switching works. Back navigation returns to Welcome.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated; migrate to boxShadow for react-native-web. Non-blocking.

action_items: Optional: replace shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius/shadowOffset with boxShadow in StyleSheet to silence deprecation warning on web.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py cleanly validates base64, strips data URLs, and routes via /api prefix.
No MongoDB _id leakage (no DB writes in this flow).
Frontend uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL correctly; testIDs are present on every interactive element.
seed_data_creation: None. Sample parent images fetched at runtime from Unsplash for generate tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Image picking is native (expo-image-picker) so end-to-end photo upload cannot be exercised on web preview - only the picker UI presence was verified. Backend generate endpoint is confirmed working with real Gemini Nano Banana calls (~9s per generation).
